name: SLU-PP-332
subtitle: 2 packages · 5–10mg per vial
description: SLU-PP-332 is a synthetic research compound studied as an agonist of the estrogen-related receptors ERRα, ERRβ and ERRγ. Preclinical literature investigates it in metabolic and mitochondrial research, including energy expenditure and oxidative metabolism in cell and animal models. It is supplied as a lyophilized vial for laboratory research only.

name: Ipamorelin
subtitle: 2 packages · 5–10mg per vial
description: Ipamorelin is a pentapeptide growth hormone secretagogue, studied as a selective agonist of the ghrelin receptor (GHSR). Published preclinical work describes it as a selective secretagogue, investigated in research on growth hormone pulses and body composition in animal models. It is supplied as a lyophilized vial for laboratory research only.

name: VIP
subtitle: 2 packages · 5–10mg per vial
description: Vasoactive intestinal peptide (VIP) is a 28-amino-acid neuropeptide studied in neuroscience, immunology and gut research. It acts through VPAC1 and VPAC2 receptors in published work, and is investigated in models of vasodilation, immune signalling and intestinal function. It is supplied as a lyophilized vial for laboratory research only.

name: Semaglutide
subtitle: 5 packages · 5–30mg per vial
description: Semaglutide is a long-acting GLP-1 receptor agonist peptide studied in metabolic research. The literature investigates GLP-1 signalling in glucose regulation, satiety pathways and energy balance in preclinical and clinical models. It is supplied as a lyophilized vial for laboratory research only.

name: Mazdutide
subtitle: 1 package · 10mg per vial
description: Mazdutide is a dual GLP-1 and glucagon receptor agonist studied in metabolic research. Published work investigates dual incretin and glucagon signalling in models of weight, glucose and lipid metabolism. It is supplied as a lyophilized vial for laboratory research only.

name: Melanotan I
subtitle: 1 package · 10mg per vial
description: Melanotan I is an analogue of alpha-melanocyte-stimulating hormone (alpha-MSH) studied in pigmentation research. It acts primarily through the melanocortin-1 receptor in published work, and is investigated in models of melanin production. It is supplied as a lyophilized vial for laboratory research only.

name: Tirzepatide
subtitle: 9 packages · 5–60mg per vial
description: Tirzepatide is a dual GIP and GLP-1 receptor agonist studied in metabolic research. The literature investigates combined incretin signalling in models of glucose control, appetite and energy balance. It is supplied as a lyophilized vial for laboratory research only.

name: Retatrutide
subtitle: 10 packages · RT5–RT60
description: Retatrutide is a triple receptor agonist studied in metabolic research, acting on GIP, GLP-1 and glucagon receptors in published work. It is investigated in models of weight, glucose and lipid metabolism. It is supplied as a lyophilized vial for laboratory research only.

name: BPC 10mg+Tb500 10mg
subtitle: 3 packages · BB10–BB30
description: This blend combines BPC-157 and TB-500 in one package for comparative laboratory research. BPC-157 is a pentadecapeptide fragment studied in tissue repair models, and TB-500 is a thymosin beta-4 fragment studied in cell migration and actin-related repair models. It is supplied as lyophilized vials for laboratory research only.

name: Tesamorelin
subtitle: 4 packages · 5–20mg per vial
description: Tesamorelin is a growth hormone-releasing hormone (GHRH) analogue studied in growth hormone and IGF-1 research. Published work investigates it in models of body composition and growth hormone signalling. It is supplied as a lyophilized vial for laboratory research only.

name: Pinealon
subtitle: 2 packages · 10–50mg per vial
description: Pinealon is a short tripeptide (Glu-Asp-Arg) studied in neuroprotection and brain ageing research. The bioregulator literature investigates it in preclinical models of neuronal function and age-related changes. It is supplied as a lyophilized vial for laboratory research only.

name: Thymosin Alpha-1
subtitle: 2 packages · 5–10mg per vial
description: Thymosin Alpha-1 is a 28-amino-acid peptide derived from prothymosin alpha, studied in immune research. Published work investigates it in models of T-cell function and immune modulation. It is supplied as a lyophilized vial for laboratory research only.

name: Semax
subtitle: 3 packages · 5–30mg per vial
description: Semax is an analogue of an ACTH fragment (ACTH 4-10 with a Pro-Gly-Pro tail) studied in neuroprotection research. The literature investigates it in animal models of brain injury, cognition and neurotrophic signalling. It is supplied as a lyophilized vial for laboratory research only.

name: Selank
subtitle: 2 packages · 5–10mg per vial
description: Selank is a tuftsin-derived heptapeptide studied in anxiety, immune and neuro research. Published animal work investigates it in models of stress responses, GABAergic signalling and neurotrophic factors. It is supplied as a lyophilized vial for laboratory research only.

name: Cagrilintide
subtitle: 2 packages · 5–10mg per vial
description: Cagrilintide is a long-acting amylin analogue studied in metabolic research. The literature investigates amylin signalling in satiety and energy balance, including in combination with GLP-1 pathways in preclinical models. It is supplied as a lyophilized vial for laboratory research only.

name: BPC-157
subtitle: 3 packages · 5–20mg per vial
description: BPC-157 is a pentadecapeptide fragment studied in tissue repair research. Published work investigates it in models of tendon, gut and wound healing, angiogenesis and cell migration. It is supplied as a lyophilized vial for laboratory research only.

name: Melanotan II
subtitle: 1 package · 10mg per vial
description: Melanotan II is a cyclic melanocortin agonist studied in pigmentation and melanocortin receptor research. It acts on MC1R and MC4R in published work, and is investigated in animal models of melanin production and melanocortin signalling. It is supplied as a lyophilized vial for laboratory research only.

name: TB-500
subtitle: 3 packages · 5–20mg per vial
description: TB-500 is a synthetic version of the thymosin beta-4 fragment studied in cell migration and repair research. Published work investigates it in models of actin sequestration, cell movement and tissue repair. It is supplied as a lyophilized vial for laboratory research only.

name: SS-31
subtitle: 2 packages · 10–50mg per vial
description: SS-31, also known as elamipretide, is a tetrapeptide studied in mitochondrial research. It targets cardiolipin in the inner mitochondrial membrane in published work, and is investigated in models of mitochondrial dysfunction, ageing and cardiac and renal function. It is supplied as a lyophilized vial for laboratory research only.

name: PT-141
subtitle: 1 package · 10mg per vial
description: PT-141, also known as bremelanotide, is a cyclic heptapeptide melanocortin agonist studied in melanocortin receptor research. It acts primarily through MC4R in published work, and is investigated in animal and clinical models of melanocortin signalling. It is supplied as a lyophilized vial for laboratory research only.

name: NAD
subtitle: 3 packages · 100–1000mg per vial
description: NAD (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide) is a coenzyme central to redox reactions and energy metabolism, studied in ageing and metabolic research. Published work investigates it in models of sirtuin signalling, mitochondrial function and cellular energy balance. It is supplied for laboratory research only.

name: MOTS-c
subtitle: 3 packages · 10–40mg per vial
description: MOTS-c is a mitochondrial-derived peptide, 16 amino acids encoded in the mitochondrial genome, studied in metabolic research. Published work investigates it in models of AMPK signalling, exercise metabolism and ageing. It is supplied as a lyophilized vial for laboratory research only.

name: KPV
subtitle: 3 packages · 5–30mg per vial
description: KPV is a tripeptide (Lys-Pro-Val), the C-terminal fragment of alpha-MSH, studied in anti-inflammatory research. Published work investigates it in gut and skin models, without the pigmentation effects associated with full melanocortin agonists in the literature. It is supplied as a lyophilized vial for laboratory research only.

name: GHK-CU
subtitle: 2 packages · 50–100mg per vial
description: GHK-Cu is a copper-bound tripeptide (Gly-His-Lys) studied in skin, collagen and wound research. Originally isolated from human plasma in published work, it is investigated in models of collagen synthesis, tissue remodelling and hair biology. It is supplied as a lyophilized vial for laboratory research only.

name: FOXO4
subtitle: 1 package · 10mg per vial
description: FOXO4 peptide is studied in senescent cell research, investigating the interaction between FOXO4 and p53 in published preclinical work. The literature explores it in models of ageing and cellular senescence. It is supplied as a lyophilized vial for laboratory research only.

name: Epithalon
subtitle: 2 packages · 10–50mg per vial
description: Epithalon is a tetrapeptide (Ala-Glu-Asp-Gly) studied in ageing research. The bioregulator literature investigates it in animal models of telomerase activity, circadian regulation and age-related changes. It is supplied as a lyophilized vial for laboratory research only.

name: CJC-1295 With DAC
subtitle: 3 packages · 2–10mg per vial
description: CJC-1295 with DAC is a long-acting growth hormone-releasing hormone (GHRH) analogue, with a Drug Affinity Complex that binds albumin in published work. It is studied in growth hormone and IGF-1 research, including models of pulsatile growth hormone release. It is supplied as a lyophilized vial for laboratory research only.

name: AOD-9604
subtitle: 2 packages · 5–10mg per vial
description: AOD-9604 is a fragment of human growth hormone (residues 176-191) studied in fat metabolism research. Published work investigates it in models of lipolysis and fat mass, without the growth hormone and IGF-1 effects described for full growth hormone in the literature. It is supplied as a lyophilized vial for laboratory research only.

name: 10-amino-1mq
subtitle: 2 packages · 5–10mg per vial
description: 5-Amino-1MQ (10-amino-1mq) is a small-molecule inhibitor of nicotinamide N-methyltransferase (NNMT) studied in metabolic research. Published preclinical work investigates NNMT inhibition in models of obesity, energy expenditure and ageing. It is supplied for laboratory research only.

name: Klow80
subtitle: 1 package · 80mg per vial
description: Klow80 is listed as a peptide blend in our catalogue, supplied as an 80mg vial package for comparative laboratory research. Its component profile is as listed on its package label; for batch documentation, check the COA Portal. It is supplied for laboratory research only.
